description.value:
You gain one of the following features: Relentless if you chose Juyo, or Punishing Charge if you chose Vaapad.

Relentless. You have advantage on initiative checks, and you gain a 10-foot bonus to your speed on your first turn of combat.

Punishing Charge. When a hostile creature you can see or hear within 30 feet of you casts a force power, you can use your reaction to move up to half your speed, ending that movement closer to the creature than where you started. If you end within 5 feet of it and the triggering power required a ranged attack roll, that roll suffers disadvantage.
